item.description:
Release v5.24.3

Changes since v5.24.2

  • feat(PluginActivityHeatmap): add project commit heatmap
  • feat(PluginMessageListBrief): add activateCurrentConversation to avoid stale selection
  • feat(PluginMessageListDetailed): add activateCurrentConversation to avoid stale selection
  • feat(PluginMessageListStandard): add activateCurrentConversation to avoid stale selection
  • feat(updates): add stable and preview channels
  • fix(ci): separate stable and preview appcast commits
  • fix(KitLLM): normalize tool result order for OpenAI compatible adapter
  • fix(PluginAgentLoop): restore ask_user tool result on resume
  • fix(provider-rail-view): avoid rebuilding rail on tab switch
  • fix(provider-rail-view): restore tab switching updates
  • fix(settings): preserve sidebar scroll position
  • refactor: unify Web Server settings page style with General settings
  • refactor(PluginQuickFileSearch): align settings layout
  • refactor(PluginQuickLauncher): align settings layout
  • refactor(PluginToolManager): align settings and log details
